text:
luis: Heads up — seeing a 5xx spike from the quantized 7B variant in eu-west1, tail latency ~3x for the last 20m. Suspect the recent quant path tweak. Need an emergency pin + hotpatch deploy in the 00:30 UTC window. Can we fast-track?

raj: Copy. We need SRE + eng approvals and release lead signoff. @tara @imogen can you ack?

tara: I see the same telemetry. Agree we should pin and roll a hotpatch. I can be SRE owner for the window. :thumbsup:

imogen: Reproduced locally with the quant flag. Quick fix ready in PR #1456 (small fallback around kernel selection). No infra/db changes.

luis: Link to PR + quick notes: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/1456 — changelog line added. Plan: pin model to v2026-04-quantfix, canary 5% for 5m then escalate. Rollback criteria: >1% error or latency >2x baseline.

deploybot: To proceed I need two human approvals and release notes present. Current gate: CLOSED.

raj: +1 from release lead. Added release draft: https://console/releases/drafts/v2026-04-quantfix

ops-oncall: I'll monitor error budget and be ready to rollback. Standby here.

imogen: +1 from Eng. Code LGTM. Prefer a short canary (5m) rather than skipping canary — safer and still fast.

tara: SRE approves expedited canary 5m. Ops: give me 15m after canary to validate infra signals.

deploybot: Deploy request accepted. Command queued: 
```
/deploy hotfix v2026-04-quantfix --region=eu-west1 --canary=5% --canary-wait=300
```

deploybot: [system] Canary started on eu-west1 (5% traffic) — 00:31 UTC

luis: Watching telemetry — initial qps and token latency look stable.

ops-oncall: No errors seen in the first 3m. Latency trending down vs the spike. :thumbsup:

tara: At +8m, infra signals are clean. Approve escalation to 50%.

deploybot: Scaling canary -> 50%... done.

imogen: 50% looks clean on my local checks and staging traces. No regressions observed.

raj: Approvals satisfied, release lead + SRE + Eng. Proceed to full rollout.

deploybot: Full rollout initiated. [system] Rollout complete at 00:42 UTC.

luis: Thanks all. Will keep an eye on the post-rollout dashboards. If anything pops, we'll revert and run postmortem.

release-bot: release v2026-04-quantfix tagged and published. Release notes: https://console/releases/v2026-04-quantfix

luis: Adding a quick postmortem placeholder in #postmortems in case we need it.
